description: Sanitize a confidential presentation file before public release. Open '/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/incident_report_draft.odp' and remove all sensitive metadata and review artifacts. Specifically: 1) Delete all comments/annotations from slides. 2) Remove user data (Author/Created By/Modified By) from File Properties. 3) Remove the custom property 'Classification' set to 'Confidential'. 4) Uncheck 'Apply user data' to prevent re-adding your info. Save the sanitized file as 'incident_report_public.odp' in the same directory.
